system.description:
You grasp a hand full of poisonous Lotus petals, spreading them enough to fill a 20-foot cube originating from yourself in a dance of serenity. A creature who’s failed this jutsu’s save once before, cannot be affected again for 1 minute.

As they flutter in front of you, all creatures within range must make a Charisma saving throw to as the pollen begins to affect their emotional state.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist most of this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature enters a calm and becomes Charmed, treating all creatures it can see as its compeller for the duration.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but this jutsu’s duration is increased to 10 minutes.
